title: Video Tools
subtitle: Temporary video and audio tools whose results do not enter project history.

seamConcat.title: Seamless Video Concatenation
seamConcat.description: Upload two videos in order, choose the tail and head trim counts, and join both streams at the frame rate of Video 1.

bridge.label: Transition method
bridge.description: Extracts four motion anchors from the two videos, generates continuous motion between them, and locks the final output back to the original endpoints. This is not a fade or overlay.
bridge.durationHelp: Four motion anchors constrain the bridge. Only the calculated central interval adds to the final duration.
bridge.promptPlaceholder: For example: the camera continues a slow push-in while the subject turns naturally

workflowNoteDirect: Direct joins are processed remotely as NVENC H.264 MP4 with yuv420p at 10 Mbit/s.
workflowNoteAi: AI bridge output uses local H.264 MP4 with Video 1 geometry and FPS, adaptive bitrate, and retained audio when available.

input1.title: Video 1
input1.description: The first part of the result and the source of the output frame rate.
input1.trimHelp: Remove this many frames from the end before joining.

input2.title: Video 2
input2.description: The second part of the result, with a configurable head trim.
input2.trimHelp: Remove this many frames and matching audio from the start.

result.title: Concatenated Result
result.description: Preview and download the output when the task completes.
result.emptyHint: Upload two videos and start concatenation. The result will appear here.
result.processingHint: The videos are being processed. Keep this page open to preview and download the result.

freeVoice.title: Free Voice
freeVoice.description: A project and its character reference voice are required to generate one temporary voice clip.
freeVoice.textPlaceholder: Enter the text to read aloud
freeVoice.emptyResults: Generated audio appears here and expires automatically after 1 day.
